constants: All on-image words are upper case (10 of 10 thumbnails with text).
Red is the one accent: red fill in 5 headlines and red arrows in 5 thumbnails, so 10 of 20 use red.
Heavy sans, one or two words in most cases; no two thumbnails share an exact typeface across the set (heavy sans, rounded sans, squared techno, condensed).
No logo, channel mark, border, box or badge on any thumbnail. Exceptions: letterbox bars on 12, a tiny unreadable corner badge on 16.
No fixed host placement; no fixed grade (mostly natural colour with saturated greens and browns).

host_treatment.faces_present: 5 of 20 (1, 11, 14, 16, 19), of which 1 and 11 are small or blurred
host_treatment.host_share: 2 of 20 (16, 19), the same man in both; identity not confirmed from pixels
host_treatment.lighting: 16: flat car daylight; 19: dark car interior lit by windscreen glow
host_treatment.cutout: only 14 uses cut-out heads, with a thin dark rim and no glow

text_rules.colours: red 5 (8, 13, 15, 17, 18); white 2 (2, 7); black 1 (10); lime green 1 (14); magenta 1 (19)
text_rules.height: 6% to 17% of frame height for the biggest line
text_rules.outline: black or dark outline on 2, 7, 10, 14; solid fill with dark shadow or none on the red headlines; no box behind any text
text_rules.highlight: no thumbnail sets one word in a second colour; each text block is one colour throughout; the only magenta text is the EF5 tag on 19

popular_vs_latest.popular_1_to_10: red arrows on 5 of 10 (2, 4, 6, 7, 10); text on 4 of 10 (2, 7, 8, 10); a person in frame on 3 of 10 (1, 2, 4), none showing a face at full size; views 1.3M to 21M

transfer.rule: Use one red arrow onto one object in the scene, with a label of one or two words where needed.
transfer.evidence: Arrows on 5 of 10 popular thumbnails (2, 4, 6, 7, 10), none on the latest 10; 7 uses HOUSE with an arrow to the event.

transfer.rule: Headline in red heavy caps, one to two words, top centre, naming the threat rather than the title's claim.
transfer.evidence: 8 NIGHTMARE EF4, 15 HIDDEN MONSTER, 17 UNSURVIVABLE, 18 RAW FOOTAGE; all four are 1 or 2 words, top centre, red.

transfer.rule: Keep one accent colour (red) on a dark or muted storm grade, with no logo, badge or border in the frame.
transfer.evidence: Red on 10 of 20 thumbnails; none of the 20 carries a logo or channel mark.
